key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as a strong US jobs report revived rate-hike expectations, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors
Iron ore market facing a structural shakeout amid geopolitical disruption, with Macarthur clearing WA bulk test but broader supply concerns mounting
Aussie banks forecast record house price falls; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget, signalling credit contraction
ASIC launches review of whistleblower complaints at Big 4 accounting firms, raising governance overhang on financials
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) lead ASX runners, reflecting speculative rotation
Australia's per-capita economy stalling vs Canada; RBA urged to pause before further rate hikes
EV sales overtake petrol cars in Australia as fuel costs soar, but hidden infrastructure costs emerge
Victoria's soaring debt draws ratings agency warnings; construction sector under stress post-Bathla collapse

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout masked by geopolitical noise; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) outperform on speculative flows; Macarthur clears WA bulk test
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from supply disruption; small-caps offer asymmetric upside but elevated volatility

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications; banks forecast record house price falls; ASIC Big 4 review adds governance risk; CBA/Westpac loyalty-fee practices under scrutiny
sectors.implications: NIM compression and credit-cycle risk weigh on CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX; governance overhang from ASIC review may pressure valuations

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel debate intensifies; energy transition costs mounting; El Nino cyclone risk to infrastructure
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, AGL.AX, Origin.AX face policy and cost-headwind uncertainty; gas pricing tailwind for upstream names

sectors.trend: EV sales surpass petrol cars for first time in Australia; hidden infrastructure and battery costs emerging; VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally
sectors.implications: Consumer rotation toward EV-adjacent names; pressure on traditional auto supply chains; WES.AX, WOW.AX may see mixed impact

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives gaining traction; CSL remains defensive anchor
sectors.implications: CSL.AX retains defensive bid; global pharma disruption may shift GLP-1 market dynamics

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals structural Ponzi dynamics in construction; housing construction to follow prices lower; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall
sectors.implications: REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX, ICPL.AX) face occupancy and capex risk; construction names (WTC.AX, MDS.AX) under pressure

Credit contraction: 15% home loan application drop signals housing cycle inflection
Commodity structural shift: iron ore shakeout, gas pricing volatility, energy transition cost overruns
Governance & regulation: ASIC Big 4 review, bank fee practices, Victoria debt warnings
Small-cap speculative rotation: miners and explorers lead runners amid large-cap weakness
EV transition inflection in Australia with hidden cost risks
Australia vs Canada growth divergence raising structural concerns

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / global rate repricing
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; monitor RBA statement and CPI data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit contraction and price falls
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce bank exposure or favour CBA.AX (strongest balance sheet); avoid construction and housing-linked REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore supply disruption / price volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify across commodity exposure; monitor BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX hedging positions
Monitor audit-firm news flow; potential spillover to listed companies relying on Big 4 audits

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overruns and gas cartel risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour upstream gas producers (Santos.AX, Woodside.AX) over downstream; watch Beetaloo policy developments

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Victoria fiscal deterioration / ratings downgrade risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor Victorian infrastructure spend impact on construction and REIT sectors

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream gas and energy names on pricing tailwind
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rate surge and Mongolian drilling push support gas pricing; Beetaloo cartel debate may accelerate policy reform benefiting producers

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap miner exposure on speculative rotation
opportunities.rationale: Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals leading runners; vanadium and critical-mines theme aligns with energy transition

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain defensive healthcare and consumer staples allocation
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and WES.AX offer relative strength in a rate-sensitive, credit-contracting environment; GLP-1 market shift supports pharma

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX lower on rate-hike fears; housing construction following prices lower; credit contraction underway
Bathla collapse signals structural Ponzi risk; 15% home loan application drop; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor bank governance risk; favour CBA over peers
defensive_moves.rationale: ASIC Big 4 review and loyalty-fee scrutiny create overhang; CBA strongest capital position but still exposed

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as rate-hike expectations persist and credit contraction data (15% loan application drop) filters through. Small-cap miners may continue to outperform on speculative flows. Watch for RBA commentary and next CPI print.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural concerns around Australia's stalling per-capita growth vs Canada, housing cycle inflection, and energy transition cost overruns suggest a cautious 6–12 month outlook. 'Bull case returns' narrative offers upside if RBA pauses and commodity prices stabilise. Iron ore shakeout could create medium-term value in large-cap miners.
